text:
marta: Heads up — after last night's rollout I'm seeing a 2-3x p99 jump for a slice of requests that hit the attention hotpath. Seems concentrated at seq_len ~1024-1536 and when KV cache is cold. Example endpoint: /v1/complete model=rflx-1.3 variant=auto

kevin: Can you paste a small profile or numbers? Is this a single-token spike or sustained during generation?

marta: Quick numbers from our perf harness (synth workload matching prod seq distribution):
```
Before (commit abc123): median=48ms p95=86ms p99=120ms
After  (commit def456): median=56ms p95=110ms p99=320ms
Workload: batch_size=2-4, seq=1024-1536, kv_hit ~30%
```
Looks like the p99 is blowing up when kv_hit=false for some requests.

rui: Does the kernel selector flip variants on the same request shape? Check /debug/kernel_choice and the selector logs. Could be picking paged variant for certain batch shapes.

marta: It does flip. For the same model & approx seq len the selector alternates between `fused_flash_fast` and `paged_flash` depending on batch composition and an internal heuristic. Reproducer I used: 
```
# runs local perf harness
./run_perf --model rflx-1.3 --variant=auto --batch=3 --seq=1200 --kv_miss=true
```

sam: If you bisect between abc123 -> def456 does it point at any change in the kernel-selection heuristics? def456 touched batching heuristics last week.

marta: I ran a quick bisect. Narrowed to def456 indeed. The commit relaxed the "effective_seq_len" calculation to favor paged kernels for mixed batches. Perf diff for kv-miss path (batch=3, seq=1200):
```
commit abc123: p99=125ms
commit def456: p99=320ms
forcing fused_flash: p99=130ms
```

kevin: @marta can you force `kernel=fused_flash` at runtime for that model (console flag) to confirm selector is root cause?

marta: Forced fused_flash in the canary — p99 dropped back to ~130ms (from 320). So selector choosing `paged_flash` is the culprit for this workload. Paging hit the overhead when KV cold and small-ish batch.

rui: I suspect the heuristic that computes effective_seq_len uses `max(seq_len) * scale` and doesn't account for per-instance kv_hit. For mixed kv_hit batches it overestimates cost and routes to paged. I'll add a unit test and a fix: compute weighted effective length by kv_hit ratio.

sam: Also consider adding a cheap KV probe for routing: probe first token KV lookup to set routing hint (low cost) before committing to paged kernels. That could avoid cold-kv misroutes.

marta: Rolling a canary pin now (pinned fused_flash for rflx-1.3) at 5% while we fix selector. Reverting last rollout for that model in the meantime.

perfbot: deploy/canary - pinned fused_flash -> 5% traffic :white_check_mark: Observing canary p99=135ms vs baseline p99=310ms. Logs uploaded: https://internal.logs/redwood/1779451234/canary.log

kevin: Great. Action items: (1) rui to patch selector unit + integration tests (2) sam to prototype KV probe idea (3) marta to keep canary pinned & monitor for 1 hour then expand if stable. I'll create a follow-up issue.

marta: Ack — monitoring dashboard: /console/models/rflx-1.3/perf with alert set if canary p99 > 200ms for 5m. I'll post updates here.
